lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: NANI! YOU'RE HEADED STRAIGHT FOR THE BRICK WALL AT EIGHTY MILES AN HOUR [beat] WITHOUT EVEN WEARING YOUR GLASSES!

lines.speaker: nani
lines.text: Relax Nix, your grandmother has been taking this sharp corner since before your father even learned [beat] to ride a tricycle without training wheels!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I thought we were just going to the grocery store, but now I’m strapped into a sidecar [beat] while Nani drifts around a police cruiser like a pro!

lines.speaker: nani
lines.text: Don't worry about those flashing sirens, those aren't real cops, they're just your Uncle Jamal and Mr. Haque [beat] helping me practice for the Grand Prix!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Wait, so the illegal street racing league was actually just a massive neighborhood tournament [beat] to see who pays for the annual block party?

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: It’s not just a block party, Nix, it’s a high-stakes competition where the loser has to cook [beat] for the entire district for an entire month!

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: And since Nani has never lost a single race in over forty years, she is the undisputed [beat] Stunt Queen of the suburbs!

lines.speaker: milli
lines.text: Look at her go, she just did a massive wheelie over a fire hydrant while holding a tray [beat] of perfectly balanced cupcakes for the finish line!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: If everyone in this family is a racing legend, then why am I the only one [beat] who gets car sick just sitting on a stationary school bus?

lines.speaker: nani
lines.text: Because you haven't realized that the racing gene only activates when you're late [beat] for a math test or a limited-time pizza sale!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: So all those times you were speeding through the city were just because you forgot to buy [beat] the special spices for the biryani tonight?

lines.speaker: nani
lines.text: Exactly, and now that you finally know the truth, grab the handlebars because [beat] it's officially your turn to win us some dessert!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I guess I’m not just Nix anymore, I’m the next heir to the most caffeinated [beat] and dangerous grocery delivery service in the entire city.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And that is how a simple trip for milk turned into Nix’s first official lesson [beat] in the high-speed traditions of the Stunt Queen.
